Chat request with response_format json_schema that validates the output structure

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "What is the temperature in Paris today?", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4", "responseFormat" => ["jsonSchema" => ["name" => "weather", "schema" => ["properties" => ["temp" => ["type" => "number"]], "required" => ["temp"], "type" => "object"]], "type" => "json_schema"]]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->chat($req);
var_dump($result->getChoices());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->getMessage()->getContent());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->finishReason);
```
